ip_top_stories.title: INF: Clarion expands Live Events as Taylor & Francis prepares for independence
ip_top_stories.summary: Taylor & Francis is preparing for independence as Clarion expands its live events business, with Informa announcing a £2.24 billion acquisition of Clarion from Blackstone. The story has direct relevance to a major academic publisher navigating a shifting media and publishing landscape.

ip_top_stories.title: Third Circuit Affirms Copyright Protection for Westlaw Headnotes and Rejects Fair Use Defense in AI Training Case
ip_top_stories.summary: The Third Circuit Court of Appeals has issued the first federal appellate ruling on fair use in AI training, affirming that Westlaw's headnotes are protected by copyright and rejecting a fair use defence by a non-generative AI system. The decision is a significant precedent for how copyright law applies to AI training on legal and other curated content.

ip_top_stories.title: EU considers copyright reform for gen-AI as US court rejects 'fair use' claim
ip_top_stories.summary: The European Commission is consulting on potential copyright reforms in the context of generative AI, including whether creators should have opt-out rights from AI training. The story runs alongside the Third Circuit's US fair use rejection, marking a pivotal moment in transatlantic AI copyright policy.

ip_top_stories.title: Anthropic uses inquiry to claim current copyright law makes AI training "impossible"
ip_top_stories.summary: Anthropic has told an official inquiry that existing copyright law makes AI training effectively impossible without reform, arguing for a new legal framework. The submission marks a significant escalation in AI companies' lobbying efforts on copyright policy.

ip_top_stories.title: Meta Wins Pivotal AI Copyright Case, Despite Judge Calling Its Claims 'Nonsense'
ip_top_stories.summary: A US court has ruled in Meta's favour in a significant AI copyright case, though the judge explicitly criticised the company's legal arguments as 'nonsense'. The outcome nonetheless represents a major win for AI developers facing copyright challenges over training data.

ip_further_links.title: Malaysia May Let Creators Stop AI From Scraping Their Work Under Proposed Copyright Changes
ip_further_links.summary: Malaysia's intellectual property office is proposing copyright amendments that would give creators the right to opt out of AI scraping of their works.

ip_further_links.title: Copyright owners may get right to opt out of AI training use
ip_further_links.summary: A report examines growing momentum in multiple jurisdictions toward giving copyright holders an explicit right to opt out of having their works used for AI training.

ip_further_links.title: EU consults on copyright landscape in the age of generative AI (via Passle)
ip_further_links.summary: The European Commission has opened a formal consultation on how copyright frameworks should adapt to the rise of generative AI, with a focus on training data and creator rights.

ip_further_links.title: Australia's ABC Rejects AI Copyright Opt-Out as Scraping Debate Intensifies
ip_further_links.summary: Australia's public broadcaster ABC has rejected an AI copyright opt-out mechanism, as the national debate over web scraping of media content intensifies.

ip_further_links.title: Hong Kong puts AI copyright legislative amendments on hold, and pivots to establishing operational guidelines
ip_further_links.summary: Hong Kong has paused plans to legislate on AI and copyright, instead opting to develop operational guidelines as an interim measure.

ip_further_links.title: Italy regulator probes AI music startup Suno over terms of service
ip_further_links.summary: Italy's competition and market authority has opened an investigation into AI music generation startup Suno over concerns about its terms of service and potential copyright implications.

ip_further_links.title: Transformative Means More Than "Powered by AI"
ip_further_links.summary: A legal commentary argues that courts should require more than an AI-generated label for a use to qualify as transformative under fair use doctrine.

ip_further_links.title: S&S Staff Balk at AI Performance-Tracking Software Talks [Metered]
ip_further_links.summary: Simon & Schuster employees have pushed back against management discussions about implementing AI-powered performance-tracking software in the workplace.

ip_further_links.title: ARIA Boss Annabelle Herd Warns Australia Against Giving AI Giants a 'Free Ride'
ip_further_links.summary: The head of the Australian Recording Industry Association has urged the Australian government not to allow AI companies to use copyrighted music without compensation or consent.

ip_further_links.title: TRACE Project Launches to Advance AI Interoperability
ip_further_links.summary: The Scholarly Kitchen reports on the launch of the TRACE project, which aims to improve interoperability between AI systems in academic and publishing contexts.
